description: This file defines enums, structs, and classes related to SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) configuration in 3GPP NR (New Radio) specifications, including resource sets, periodicity, spatial relations, and transmission parameters.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config
classes.description: Main structure for configuring SRS resources, including resource sets, individual resources, position resources, and related parameters.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_resource_set
classes.description: Defines a set of SRS resources with parameters like resource IDs, usage, power control, and timing.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_resource
classes.description: Represents an individual SRS resource with parameters such as ports, frequency hopping, resource mapping, and spatial relation.

classes.name: ocudu::srs_config::srs_pos_resource
classes.description: Defines position-specific SRS resources with parameters for timing, frequency, and spatial relation.

methods.name: to_string(srs_resource_type res_type)
methods.description: Converts an srs_resource_type enum value to its string representation.
